_note: Event pages, shown at event.html?e=<slug>. Made and edited on events-admin.html (Event pages), not by hand. Each is a draft ("draft": true, no publish date) or has a publish date (UK time). A draft, or a page before its publish date, shows only a Coming soon card (js/event-gate.js) and can be opened by the admin with Preview. From the publish date the page is public and, until the event has finished, is featured on the homepage Events section with its image and tagline. Images are in images/events/ or on the image storage. js/event-page.js draws the page.

events.organisers: SheDrivesElectric presents, in collaboration with MT3UK and Chargeheads
events.address: Houndshill House, Banbury Road, Ettington, Stratford-upon-Avon, CV37 7NS
description: 🎃 FRUNK OR TREAT UK 🎃
Saturday 31 October 2026 2PM – 5PM Caffeine & Machine – The Hill, Stratford-upon-Avon CV37 7NS
ENTRY: £10 PER CAR Your £10 entry is fully redeemable against food, drink and shop purchases at Caffeine & Machine, so spend it while you’re there and it’s effectively free entry!
👻 WHAT IS FRUNK OR TREAT?
Frunk or Treat is something the EV community in the USA has been having fun with for years — and now SheDrivesElectric is bringing it to the UK! 🇬🇧⚡️
The idea is brilliantly simple: open your frunk (front trunk), decorate it for Halloween and put it on display! 🎃
If you don’t have a frunk but your car is a full EV then the boot will do 👻
Go spooky, funny, ridiculous, cute or completely over the top. Zombies, ghosts, aliens, vampires, pumpkins, monsters — anything goes.
And yes, leaving sweets/candy in your frunk for visitors is very much encouraged! 🍬🍭
🏆 BEST DRESSED FRUNK CONTEST!
We’ll also be choosing a Best Dressed Frunk — and the winner will receive a FREE SET OF CAR MATS from our awesome sponsor 3W Mats @3WAutoLifeUK! 🎉
So if you needed an excuse to go completely over the top with your Halloween frunk… this is it! 👻🎃

events.name: Race of Remembrance track day 2026
events.title: Race of remembrance - Track day
events.tagline: Race of Remembrance Launch Track Day
description: Sign up to enjoy a track day and deliver passenger rides for members of the Armed Forces Community, supporting Mission Motorsport

Mission Motorsport, The Forces’ Motorsport Charity, is proud to launch the 2026 Race of Remembrance from Thruxton Circuit. Meet the teams taking part and join beneficiaries and supporters in the paddock as preparations begin for the charity’s flagship event; a remembrance service with an endurance race attached.

With the track open, you’ll have a rare chance to take part in the action. Support the Armed Forces community by offering your passenger seat to a member of the Armed Forces community. All proceeds go to Mission Motorsport who are dedicated to helping those who have served, by creating life-changing opportunities in motorsport and the automotive industry.

First and foremost, this is a day of recovery sport for our beneficiaries, giving them the opportunity to enjoy thrilling passenger rides, connect with others, and engage with supporters of the charity.
Please note: A static noise test will be in place - a strict 90dBs.
highlights: EXPERIENCE THE THRILL AT THE UK’S FASTEST RACE CIRCUIT

steps.title: This is your chance to meet our fantastic forces community and treat them to an unforgettable day.
A chance to give back, we guarantee that you'll come away fulfilled, feeling good and wanting to do it all over again!
All those going out on track must ensure that: Both arms & legs are covered.
Helmets are worn at all times whilst out on track.
Please note that all cars are subject to noise testing. The limit is a STRICT 90dB.
Food is available to purchase from the onsite facilities.
All the monies raised will be used to directly fund Mission Motorsport's work

description: • The Mountain: The circuit's most famous and thrilling feature, a steep, undulating section where fast motorcycles and cars dramatically go airborne by several feet. • Character: A tight, twisty, and highly undulating roller-coaster layout winding through open parkland and woods. • Focus: While narrow for modern top-tier car racing, motorcycle racing is king here, most notably hosting the annual Bennetts British Superbike Championship "Party in the Park" event in August.

events.name: The Motorist Car Meet
events.title: The Motorist Car Meet
events.address: New Lennerton Lane, Sherburn in Elmet, LS25 6JE
description: Join Us for the Ultimate Tesla Meet at The Motorist, Leeds!
​Get ready to plug in and turn heads. We’re bringing together the region’s best EV community for a Tesla meet at Yorkshire’s premier automotive hub—The Motorist in Sherburn in Elmet, Leeds.

Whether you drive a daily-driven Model 3, a tuned Model Y, an iconic Model X, or a classic Model S, park up alongside fellow owners, chat builds, share track-day data, and enjoy a full morning surrounded by cutting-edge EV technology.

Why The Motorist is Worth the Trip Set in the Yorkshire countryside just outside Leeds, The Motorist isn't just a parking lot—it’s the UK’s ultimate destination for motoring culture. Spacious 800+ Capacity Grounds: Purpose-built for high-volume meets with ample parking, wide bays, and smooth tarmac access. The Arnage & Driver's Lounge: Grab a top-tier breakfast, artisan coffee, or a proper hot meal at their famous onsite restaurant and café. The Store & Onsite Garage: Browse curated automotive merchandise, detailing supplies, and clothing, or inspect their fully equipped workshop and bodyshop. Great Community Vibe: Family- and dog-friendly with an inclusive, welcoming atmosphere for enthusiasts across all eras and powertrains.
